name: WayriCAD Constraint Studio
description: Protocol presets, clearance matrices, scoped profiles and reviewed project export.
description_full: Inspect saved rules and scope in a read-only overview. Compose protocol presets, pairwise clearance matrices, reusable rule sets, BGA managed regions and scoped layer/via profiles. General rule editing belongs in KiCad's Design Rule Editor; netclasses and board constraints remain in Board Setup. Saved-project staging, source checks and reviewed offline apply remain available. KiCad 10 testing target.
